sections.Profile:
The "Marathon" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1955, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features two flippers, five pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and two gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1955

- Type: Electro-Mechanical
